name: Tanchjim Bunny
driver_detail: 10mm DMT4 Ultra Dynamic Driver with PET-Titanium diaphragm & acoustic labyrinth maze
sound_description: Clean, linear bass, forward natural vocals, and smooth, non-fatiguing treble. Warm and relaxing.
build_material: Clear polycarbonate shell, resin faceplate
cable_detail: Detachable 0.78mm 2-pin; DSP edition features built-in DAC/AMP & Tanchjim app EQ
accessories_included: Silicone tips (S/M/L), cloth storage pouch, manual
qc_and_known_issues: Lightweight plastic shell feels budget; otherwise rock-solid with zero driver flex.
notes: Available in Bunny 3.5mm, Bunny DSP (USB-C), and Bunny G (Gaming edition with 8-band PEQ in app).
tagline: Tiny, featherweight, and great for sleeping or small ears.
sound_summary: Balanced, warm, and relaxing with clean, natural vocals and smooth treble that never fatigues.
takeaway: An ultra-compact budget gem that completely disappears into the ear. If your phone lacks a headphone jack, grab the USB-C DSP edition. It features a built-in DAC and lets you tweak an 8-band parametric EQ directly from the Tanchjim app.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm nozzle • Very comfortable for small ear canals & side sleeping.

name: Kefine Klean
driver_detail: 10mm Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) Dynamic Driver + N52 neodymium magnet
sound_description: Clean, punchy low end, crisp transients, holographic imaging. Includes swappable silver (warm/smooth) and black (resolving/bright) nozzles.
build_material: Aviation-grade full CNC cast alloy metal
cable_detail: High-purity silver-plated copper 2-pin 0.78mm braided cable
accessories_included: 2 pairs tuning nozzles with rubber gaskets, solid zipper case, 2 styles silicone ear tips
qc_and_known_issues: Exceptional QC, durable metal finish without paint chipping. Slightly heavier shell (9.8g per side).
notes: Follow-up to the hit Delci, offering interchangeable acoustic nozzles at an even lower price point.
tagline: All-metal CNC alloy shell with two swappable tuning nozzles.
sound_summary: Energetic, punchy, and highly resolving with crisp dynamic driver attack.
takeaway: Kefine's successor to the beloved Delci. Built like a little tank out of machined alloy, it includes two screw-on brass nozzles: the silver nozzle gives an airy, detailed presentation, while the black nozzle adds warmth and sub-bass weight.
fit_verdict: 5.6mm nozzle • Ergonomic curved metal housing with an easy seal.

name: TRN Conch
driver_detail: 10mm Dual-Magnetic Circuit DLC Dynamic Driver
sound_description: Sparkly highs, energetic sub-bass, fast transients. Can be bright on Reference nozzle; tamable with Atmospheric nozzle or foam tips.
build_material: Liquid metal alloy cavity with electroplated mirror finish
cable_detail: 4-core silver-plated OFC modular cable with interchangeable 2.5/3.5/4.4mm jacks
accessories_included: 3 modular plug adapters (3.5/2.5/4.4), 3 pairs tuning nozzles, metal puck case, TRN T-Ear tips + wide bore tips
qc_and_known_issues: Treble can be intense for treble-sensitive listeners; mirror chrome finish attracts fingerprints and micro-scratches.
notes: Holds the record for best sub-$35 accessories with 3 modular plugs and 3 tuning nozzle filters.
tagline: The undisputed accessory champion of budget Chi-Fi.
sound_summary: Crisp, bright, and detailed with fast, punchy bass.
takeaway: Unbeatable value inside the box: you get full metal shells, three interchangeable tuning nozzles, a premium modular cable with swappable 2.5mm, 3.5mm, and 4.4mm plugs, and an aluminum hard-shell carrying case. Sound is on the brighter, more analytical side.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Standard comfortable fit, but can feel heavy due to solid metal shells.

name: DUNU Titan X
driver_detail: 10mm Dual-Magnetic Dual-Chamber Dynamic Driver with high-rigidity dome
sound_description: Authoritative bass punch, natural warm vocal presence, and smooth, non-fatiguing treble. Excellent dynamic slam.
build_material: High-density chrome-plated metallic alloy
cable_detail: Silver-plated copper Litz cable (0.78mm 2-pin)
accessories_included: DUNU Candy ear tips, cleaning brush, soft leatherette pouch, standard tips
qc_and_known_issues: DUNU's industrial QC is top-tier; shell mirror finish collects fingerprints.
notes: DUNU's 2026 entry-level disruptor. Includes DUNU Candy tips which are prized audiophile accessories on their own.
tagline: Mecha-styled dynamic set with rich bass slam and Candy tips.
sound_summary: Warm, punchy, and dynamic with satisfying sub-bass rumble.
takeaway: DUNU's stylish chrome-plated set featuring a dual-chamber dynamic driver. Bass has genuine physical punch and vocals sound rich and natural. Comes with DUNU's famous Candy silicone tips in the box, which provide one of the best acoustic seals available.
fit_verdict: 5.6mm nozzle • Angled sound bore with comfortable ergonomic seating.

name: KZ ZAR
driver_detail: 8 Drivers per side: 10mm DD + 6x 50024S BAs (mids/highs) + 1x 30019S BA (ultra-high)
sound_description: Massive sub-bass slam, wide cinematic soundstage, forward vocals, crisp high frequency micro-details without the harsh sibilance of older KZ sets.
build_material: Resin cavity with zinc alloy electroplated faceplate
cable_detail: 8-strand silver-plated cable with hooded QDC 2-pin connectors
accessories_included: Starline silicone ear tips (3 sizes), 8-strand cable
qc_and_known_issues: Shell is large and heavy due to 8 drivers; QDC connector limits cable swaps; BA timbre can sound slightly unnatural on acoustic acoustic guitars.
notes: Packs 8 drivers per ear. If bought during AliExpress sales, it is an astonishing amount of raw acoustic hardware under €45.
tagline: Chunky 8-driver hybrid beast with massive theatrical bass.
sound_summary: Full-bodied U-curve with booming sub-bass and sparkling treble.
takeaway: If you love big, energetic, cinematic sound for electronic music, movies, or gaming explosions, this 1DD + 7BA hybrid delivers immense power and a wide soundstage. Keep in mind the shells are on the larger side, so they suit medium to large ears best.
fit_verdict: 6.0mm nozzle • Large chunky shell; not recommended for very small ears.

name: Kiwi Ears Cadenza II
driver_detail: 10mm Titanium-Coated PET DD with KARS 2.0 Acoustic Labyrinth Resonator
sound_description: Clean, tight sub-bass shelf that rolls off cleanly at 200Hz, preventing lower-mid mud. Luscious vocal presence and smooth airy highs.
build_material: Medical resin shell with CNC machined aluminum faceplate
cable_detail: High-purity 4-core braided single-crystal OFC cable (0.78mm 2-pin)
accessories_included: 3 pairs balanced silicone tips, 3 pairs vocal silicone tips, storage pouch
qc_and_known_issues: Seamless resin build, zero driver flex, excellent acoustic chamber stability.
notes: Successor to the legendary original Cadenza. KARS 2.0 acoustic tube ensures clean bass separation.
tagline: One of the most natural, musical vocal tunings under €50.
sound_summary: Smooth, warm-neutral balance with lush acoustic timbre.
takeaway: A perennial favorite for acoustic music, female vocals, and indie rock. The 3D-printed resin shells look like custom artisan jewelry, and the beryllium/titanium diaphragm produces an organic, warm midrange with zero harshness or sibilance.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Featherweight resin cavity that fits almost any ear effortlessly.

name: ooopusX Op.22
driver_detail: Coaxial 10mm + 8mm Dynamic Drivers (silicone carbon dome) + 2 Balanced Armatures
sound_signature: Dual Mode: Neutral Mode / Bass Boost Mode
sound_description: Rotary knob on shell switches between Neutral Mode (balanced, clear vocals, fast transients) and Bass Mode (+6dB sub-bass shelf for massive punch).
build_material: Cyberpunk-styled translucent resin shell with mechanical rotary dial
cable_detail: Detachable 2-pin 0.78mm copper braided cable
accessories_included: 3 pairs silicone tips, standard cable, user manual
qc_and_known_issues: Shell is slightly bulky; ensure both rotary knobs are set to the identical dot alignment to prevent channel imbalance.
notes: Features a hardware physical dial so you can switch between competitive gaming clarity and fun bass without touching software EQ.
tagline: Dual-mode hybrid with an on-shell physical rotary tuning switch.
sound_summary: Switchable between clean neutral monitor sound and energetic bass boost.
takeaway: A unique 2DD + 2BA hybrid with a mechanical rotary switch on the faceplate. You can flick the dial with your thumbnail between a clean, flat monitoring curve and a punchy, bass-boosted fun curve without fiddling with digital EQ apps.
fit_verdict: 5.8mm nozzle • Medium shell profile with comfortable resin contours.

name: Truthear Gate
driver_detail: 10mm Carbon LCP dome composite diaphragm + PU suspension, N52 double-cavity magnet
sound_description: Clean, balanced, highly coherent. Natural midrange, smooth treble that avoids fatigue. Successor to the celebrated Hola.
build_material: Lightweight transparent polycarbonate shell with CNC faceplate
cable_detail: Unusually thick, soft oxygen-free copper twisted 2-pin cable (punches way above $20 tier)
accessories_included: 4 pairs silicone tips, thick OFC cable, soft storage pouch
qc_and_known_issues: Exceptional QC and build consistency; lean sub-bass for extreme bassheads, but remarkable clarity.
notes: The safest $20 entry into IEMs. The stock cable alone is worth $15.
tagline: The successor to the Hola: clean neutral sound and a fantastic cable.
sound_summary: Clean, linear neutral sound with an easy, fatigue-free warmth.
takeaway: Truthear replaced the legendary Hola with the Gate. Transparent faceplates reveal the 10mm carbon LCP driver inside. Sound is remarkably clean and balanced with near-zero distortion, and the included 4-strand OFC cable is unusually thick and tangle-free for this price.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm nozzle • Very light and comfortable for all-day listening sessions.

name: 7Hz G1 (Salnotes G1)
driver_detail: 10mm Dual-Magnetic Dual-Cavity DLC Dynamic Driver (18Ω)
sound_description: Punchy sub-bass slam, clear lower-mids, lifted energetic treble. Tuned specifically for fast transient response and positional audio cues.
build_material: Matte black all-metal alloy shell
cable_detail: Silver-plated copper 2-pin 0.78mm cable with optional inline microphone
accessories_included: Silicone ear tips, carrying pouch, cable
qc_and_known_issues: Durable all-metal shell; feels cold when first inserted; treble can be lively on poorly mastered music tracks.
notes: Engineered for competitive shooters (CS2, Valorant, Apex, Warzone) with laser-sharp footstep localization.
tagline: Fast DLC driver with crisp transients for tactical gaming and rock.
sound_summary: Punchy Harman V-shape with swift attack and clean high-end snap.
takeaway: A solid metal-faceplate earphone featuring a 10mm diamond-like carbon (DLC) driver. The transient speed is noticeably fast, making drum hits crisp and giving tactical multiplayer gamers pinpoint directional awareness for footsteps and reloads.
fit_verdict: 5.6mm nozzle • Compact shell with good passive noise isolation.

name: 7Hz Elua Ultra
driver_detail: Dual Dynamic Driver (10mm woofer + 8mm tweeter LCP diaphragms)
sound_description: Cohesive dual-driver low end, smooth vocal presentation, relaxed non-fatiguing treble. Zero BA metallic grain.
build_material: Lightweight resin shell with polished silver faceplate
cable_detail: Detachable 0.78mm 2-pin OFC cable
accessories_included: Silicone ear tips (3 sizes), basic pouch
qc_and_known_issues: Reliable resin seal; sound signature is very polite/safe, not for hyper-analytical detail seekers.
notes: Great alternative for listeners who want the dual-driver authority of Truthear Zero without the huge nozzle girth.
tagline: Dual dynamic drivers tuned for smooth, relaxed study marathons.
sound_summary: Smooth, warm Harman profile with effortless low-end extension.
takeaway: Combines a 10mm dynamic driver for deep sub-bass and an 8mm driver for mids and highs. It has an easygoing, warm presentation that never pierces, making it an ideal companion for long workdays, studying, or background listening.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Lightweight ergonomic shells.

name: Tripowin Vivace
driver_detail: 10mm Titanium-Plated PET Dynamic Driver (Tuned with 0DiBi)
sound_description: Tight, fast bass shelf, elevated upper-mid pinna gain, extended crisp highs. Designed to prioritize acoustic imaging and separation.
build_material: Medical-grade 3D printed resin cavity
cable_detail: Soft braided Tripowin silver-plated copper cable (famous for supple ergonomics)
accessories_included: Tripowin braided cable, 3 pairs silicone tips
qc_and_known_issues: Lightweight sub-bass makes it less ideal for hip-hop/EDM; purely tuned for competitive tactical audio.
notes: Collaboration with 0DiBi. One of the top-rated IEMs under €40 specifically for Valorant, CS2, and Apex Legends.
tagline: Co-engineered with acoustic tuners for pinpoint 3D imaging.
sound_summary: Fast, crisp, and revealing with wide directional soundstage.
takeaway: Tuned with the assistance of acoustic engineers (0DiBi) specifically to maximize stereo imaging and separation. If you play competitive tactical shooters (Valorant, CS2, Apex) or love complex layered electronic productions, this set separates every element clearly.
fit_verdict: 5.3mm nozzle • Slim nozzle profile that seals easily with standard tips.

name: Truthear x Crinacle Zero:RED
driver_detail: Dual Dynamic Drivers (10mm woofer + 7.8mm tweeter) with specialized acoustic crossover
sound_signature: IEF Neutral with Sub-Bass Boost (+ Tunable Bass)
sound_description: Crinacle's reference target. Ultra-low distortion (<0.2% THD), natural timbre, clean mids. Included 10Ω adapter adds +2.5dB sub-bass.
nozzle_warning: CRITICAL FIT WARNING (6.2mm nozzle can cause pain for small ears)
build_material: Dark red 3D printed DLP medical resin shell (HeyGears)
cable_detail: Detachable 0.78mm 2-pin black twisted cable; includes 10Ω bass booster impedance adapter
accessories_included: 10Ω bass impedance adapter, soft black leatherette case, 6 pairs silicone tips (narrow/wide bore), 1 pair foam tips
qc_and_known_issues: Near-zero acoustic defects; but the massive 6.2mm nozzle causes discomfort for small-to-medium ear canals after 45 minutes.
notes: The $55 benchmark for tonal accuracy. Buy from Amazon.de first if unsure about your ear canal size.
tagline: Crinacle's dual-driver reference benchmark (warning: wide nozzle).
sound_summary: Clean IEF neutral with a dedicated 10mm subwoofer for deep sub-bass.
takeaway: Widely considered the sub-€60 benchmark for tonal accuracy. One driver acts as a dedicated subwoofer while the other handles mids and highs, producing exceptionally clean instrument separation. Includes a 10-ohm impedance adapter for an extra +2.5dB bass boost. Note: the 6.2mm nozzle is thick, so avoid if you have narrow ear canals.
fit_verdict: 6.2mm nozzle ⚠️ • Wide sound bore; can cause fatigue in smaller ears.

name: Truthear x Crinacle ZERO:BLUE 2 (Blue2)
driver_detail: Upgraded Dual Dynamic Drivers (10mm + 7.8mm high-flux magnet)
sound_description: Punchy sub-bass slam, forward vocal clarity, and detailed sparkling treble. Tighter and cleaner than original Blue, with upgraded drivers.
build_material: Ergonomic 3D printed blue resin shell with revised low-profile contour
cable_detail: Upgraded 2-strand high-purity copper & silver-plated coaxial cable
accessories_included: Leatherette pouch, 6 pairs silicone tips, 1 pair foam tips
qc_and_known_issues: Substantially fixed the primary complaint of the original Zero (the fat nozzle). Easier to drive off phones.
notes: The 2025 Blue2 edition solved the infamous fit problem of the original Blue, making it a stellar all-rounder.
tagline: The original bass-slam sensation with an updated, slimmer nozzle.
sound_summary: Energetic Harman curve with visceral sub-bass punch.
takeaway: The fun sibling to the Zero:Red. It delivers deep, satisfying subwoofer rumble that makes pop, hip-hop, electronic music, and movie action sequences feel alive. The updated revision slimmed the nozzle down to 5.5mm for a much friendlier fit.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Slimmed down from original revision; much more comfortable.

name: Kefine Delci (and Delci AE)
driver_detail: 10mm DLC + PU Composite Dynamic Driver (Delci AE adds interchangeable nozzles)
sound_description: Addictive, deep, textured sub-bass with zero mid-bass bloat. Natural acoustic timbre, silky smooth treble. Pure musical enjoyment.
build_material: Aviation-grade CNC aluminum shell (ultra compact, featherlight)
cable_detail: Thick dual-tone copper braided 0.78mm 2-pin cable
accessories_included: Hard zippered protective case, 2 sets of silicone tips (vocal & balanced)
qc_and_known_issues: Flawless CNC build, zero paint chipping, highly reliable driver; note big price markup on Amazon DE (€82 vs €44 on Ali sales).
notes: Delci AE (Angel Ears edition) adds gold/silver tuning nozzles. High Amazon DE markup makes importing on AliExpress highly recommended.
tagline: The community's favorite comfort set: luxurious metal & warm bass.
sound_summary: Warm, lush, and rich with textured, velvety bass rumble.
takeaway: One of the easiest recommendations in modern Chi-Fi. Crafted from smooth aircraft-grade aluminum, the shells are tiny and slip into your ears with zero hotspots. The sound is warm, relaxing, and deeply musical with zero harshness. Pure listening enjoyment.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm nozzle • Outstanding comfort, one of the best shells on the market.

name: Moondrop May
driver_detail: 10mm Sapphire-plated Dynamic Driver + 6mm Annular Planar Magnetic Tweeter
sound_signature: Planar Sparkle + DD Slam (Fully DSP Configurable)
sound_description: Combines dynamic driver bass slam with planar magnetic ultra-fast treble extension. Integrated DSP chip stores custom PEQ profiles directly in the cable.
build_material: Medical-grade 3D printed resin cavity with stainless steel faceplate
cable_detail: USB-C DSP cable with integrated 32-bit DAC/Amp chip, 3-button remote, and microphone
accessories_included: Leatherette zip pouch, Moondrop silicone tips, USB-C DSP cable
qc_and_known_issues: Moondrop Link app works great on Android, but iOS app has restricted DSP write access. Requires USB-C host port.
notes: No dongle DAC needed. Plug directly into your phone or PC and choose between 5 factory tuning presets or write your own PEQ.
tagline: Dynamic + Planar hybrid with custom app EQ via USB-C.
sound_summary: Fast planar treble detail anchored by dynamic driver bass slam.
takeaway: Features a hybrid setup of a dynamic driver for bass and a planar magnetic driver for sparkly, detailed highs. Plugs straight into your phone or laptop with its USB-C cable and lets you download community EQ curves or make your own via the Moondrop Link app.
fit_verdict: 5.6mm nozzle • 3D-printed HeyGears medical resin with smooth fit.

name: Moondrop Aria 2
driver_detail: TiN Ceramic-Coated Dome Composite Dynamic Driver with brass acoustic cavity
sound_signature: Moondrop VDSF Target / Smooth Warm Harman
sound_description: Silky, sweet vocal presentation, rich lower midrange, extended natural treble, and lush soundstage. Very refined single dynamic timbre.
build_material: CNC milled alloy shell with electroplated matte champagne finish
cable_detail: Litz OFC silver-plated modular cable with screw-lock swappable 3.5mm and 4.4mm plugs
accessories_included: Modular cable with 3.5mm & 4.4mm plugs, white leatherette puck case, replacement screw-off nozzles and acoustic filters
qc_and_known_issues: Electroplated finish fixed the old Aria paint-peeling issue; brass screw-off nozzles make cleaning moisture-clogged filters effortless.
crinacle_rank: B (Original Aria was B, Aria 2 refined)
notes: Includes both 3.5mm and 4.4mm modular plugs and spare acoustic filters in the box.
tagline: The luxury classic evolved: ceramic dome driver & modular cable.
sound_summary: Smooth, refined Moondrop house curve with lush female vocals.
takeaway: The successor to the legendary Aria. Moondrop fixed the old paint-peeling issue with a durable electroplated alloy finish, added screw-off brass nozzle filters for easy cleaning, and packed in a luxury modular cable with both 3.5mm and 4.4mm balanced plugs.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Solid, reassuring metal weight with smooth contours.

name: Truthear Hexa
driver_detail: 10mm PU + LCP Dynamic Driver (bass) + 3 Custom Balanced Armatures (mids/highs)
sound_description: The undisputed sub-$100 reference benchmark. Flat, transparent, resolving, zero bass bleed, pristine instrumental separation.
build_material: DLP 3D-printed resin cavity by HeyGears with matte CNC aluminum faceplate
cable_detail: 4-strand black high-purity OFC 2-pin 0.78mm cable
accessories_included: Soft leatherette pouch, 3 sizes narrow-bore tips, 3 sizes wide-bore tips, 1 pair memory foam tips
qc_and_known_issues: Extremely reliable medical-grade resin; low bass shelf may sound lean for listeners accustomed to commercial bass-heavy tuning.
notes: Universally acknowledged as the cleanest technical reference performer under €100.
tagline: The sub-€100 king for critical listening, mixing, and acoustic clarity.
sound_summary: Strictly flat, analytical neutral reference with surgical separation.
takeaway: The benchmark for anyone who wants to hear their music exactly as recorded. 1 dynamic driver gives clean, unbloated bass while 3 balanced armatures carve out microscopic details in vocals, acoustic guitars, and orchestral layers. Zero fluff, pure transparency.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Lightweight matte HeyGears resin shell.

name: GK Kunten (Groove Keeper)
driver_detail: 10mm Super-Linear Dynamic Driver (43Ω, 109dB)
sound_description: Punchy textured sub-bass, clear open midrange, and airy non-fatiguing treble. Astonishing technical resolution for a ~$12 IEM.
build_material: Lightweight resin shell with metal faceplate (semi-open rear venting)
cable_detail: Detachable 1.2m QDC 2-pin cable (basic quality)
accessories_included: Basic silicone ear tips, QDC 2-pin cable
qc_and_known_issues: Ultra-budget packaging; stock cable is thin; but raw acoustic performance competes with $35 sets.
notes: Often misspelled as 'GK Kuten'. Released by KZ's experimental GK division to undercut the sub-$20 market.
tagline: The ultra-budget daily beater set for backpacks and workouts.
sound_summary: Punchy, balanced V-shape with lively bass and clean vocals.
takeaway: At under €15 on sale, this is the ultimate carefree pair. It sounds surprisingly punchy and balanced, and if you drop it on the sidewalk or leave it in a gym locker, you won't lose sleep. A great backup set to keep in your jacket pocket.
fit_verdict: 5.5mm nozzle • Extremely lightweight resin shell.

name: 7Hz x Crinacle Zero:2
driver_detail: 10mm Upgraded Dynamic Driver (flexible PU + metal composite)
sound_description: Added +3dB bass warmth compared to original Salnotes Zero, with a smoother, relaxed treble. Highly musical and forgiving of low-bitrate audio.
build_material: Angular polycarbonate composite shell with metal accent plate
cable_detail: Upgraded silver-plated copper 0.78mm 2-pin cable
accessories_included: Multi-colored rainbow silicone tips (6 pairs), standard cable
qc_and_known_issues: Stock rainbow tips can feel stiff; swapping to KBear 07 or SpinFit tips elevates comfort; very durable build.
notes: Co-tuned with Crinacle to fix the slightly bass-light sound of the original Zero. Universally recommended.
tagline: The safest first IEM recommendation in the world.
sound_summary: Warm Harman tuning with +3dB of punchy, engaging bass.
takeaway: Crinacle teamed up with 7Hz to improve upon the legendary Salnotes Zero. They added just the right amount of warm low-end punch to make rock, hip-hop, and pop tracks sound full and fun, while preserving crisp mids and a comfortable angular shell.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm nozzle • Universally easy seal and very light on the ears.

name: Tangzu Wan'er S.G II (Wan'er 2)
driver_detail: 10mm Upgraded PET Diaphragm Dynamic Driver with refined acoustic chamber
sound_description: Sweet, luscious vocal midrange, smooth non-fatiguing highs, and warm, round bass punch. Available in standard and 'Red Lion' bass editions.
build_material: Transparent sculpted resin with Chinese calligraphy faceplate
cable_detail: Detachable 0.78mm 2-pin OFC braided cable
accessories_included: Includes premium Tang Sancai silicone ear tips (a $10 bonus!), standard cable
qc_and_known_issues: Lightweight resin shell; includes genuine Tang Sancai tips with pressure-release texture; zero driver flex.
notes: Includes Tang Sancai patented ear tips in the box. Unbeatable for vocal clarity and timbral warmth under €20.
tagline: The vocal lover's paradise, now including Tang Sancai tips.
sound_summary: Sweet, intimate, forward vocals with smooth, warm acoustics.
takeaway: Renowned for how naturally and intimately it renders human voices and acoustic instruments. Japanese and English female vocals sound luscious without ever piercing. The new edition includes Tangzu's premium Tang Sancai tips in the box, which are famous for their comfortable medical-grade silicone texture.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm nozzle • Classic ergonomic resin shell.

name: Moondrop Chu II / Chu 3
driver_detail: 10mm Al-Mg Alloy Composite Dynamic Driver (Chu 3 features PopAvg-DF JM-1 tuning)
sound_description: Punchy sub-bass slam, clear intimate midrange, and airy treble. Chu 3 iteration adds thicker vocal density and warmer mid-bass.
build_material: Cast zinc alloy metal housing (matte black or silver)
cable_detail: Detachable 0.78mm 2-pin cable (huge improvement over Chu 1's fixed cable)
accessories_included: Black silicone tips, felt pouch, Chu II includes screw-off brass nozzles
qc_and_known_issues: Zinc alloy can chip paint if dropped or jumbled with keys; moisture can accumulate on filters in humid climates (keep in dry pouch).
notes: Chu II has replaceable screw-off brass nozzles; Chu 3 has fixed brass nozzles with warmer mid-bass body. Both fit easily into tiny ear canals.
tagline: Flush-fitting metal earbuds you can comfortably sleep in.
sound_summary: Crisp, lively Harman tuning with punchy sub-bass.
takeaway: Tiny cast-alloy metal earphones that sit completely flush inside the ear bowl, so you can lie your head flat against a pillow without discomfort. Features a detachable 2-pin cable and replaceable screw-off brass nozzle filters to prevent wax clogging.
fit_verdict: 5.3mm nozzle (Ultra-slim bore) • One of the best possible fits for tiny ears.

name: Moondrop Space Travel
driver_detail: 13mm Titanium-Dome Composite Diaphragm Dynamic Driver with CCAW voice coil
sound_description: Exceptional vocal clarity and tonal balance tuned to Moondrop VDSF. Tight sub-bass punch without mid-bass mud, natural vocal timbre, and smooth, non-fatiguing treble.
build_material: Lightweight resin stem, open-cockpit acrylic charging case
cable_detail: True Wireless (No cable); USB-C charging dock & short charging cable included
accessories_included: Custom shallow silicone ear tips (S/M/L), USB-C charging cable, anime user manual
qc_and_known_issues: Open lidless case attracts pocket dust and lint; 4-hour battery life per charge is modest.
notes: Features official Mitsuki Yuki anime voice prompts for ANC modes (Shh, Hey!, Umm?). 55ms low latency gaming mode activated by 4 taps on the faceplate.
tagline: The legendary sub-€25 wireless earphone that brought audiophile tuning to true wireless.
sound_summary: Accurate, natural midrange and controlled sub-bass that easily outperforms most €100 mainstream wireless earbuds in vocal realism.
takeaway: The original budget wireless benchmark that proved inexpensive Bluetooth earbuds do not have to sound bloated or muddy. Tuned strictly to the Moondrop VDSF target curve, it provides remarkably clean vocal clarity with punchy sub-bass and functional 35dB feedforward ANC. It includes Mitsuki Yuki anime voice prompts and a 55ms low latency mode. Trade-offs: 4-hour battery life per charge and an open, lidless case that collects pocket lint.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm oval nozzle • Very lightweight stem fit with shallow silicone tips.

name: Moondrop Space Travel 2
driver_detail: 13mm Beryllium-Plated Dome Dynamic Driver with upgraded DSP architecture & AI NPU
sound_description: Refined Moondrop VDSF curve with improved transient response from the beryllium dome. Clean vocals, textured sub-bass, and full 5-band parametric EQ customization via the Moondrop Link app.
build_material: Lightweight resin stem, upgraded magnetic retention transparent dock
cable_detail: True Wireless (No cable); Type-C charging case with enhanced retention magnets
accessories_included: Custom shallow silicone ear tips (S/M/L), USB-C charging cable, manual
qc_and_known_issues: Retailers advise against updating to unverified firmware 1.5.0 in the app; case remains lidless.
notes: Upgraded with Bluetooth 6.0, dual-device multipoint, and an on-chip AI NPU for call noise reduction. Space Travel 2 Ultra edition is also available with a 13mm annular planar driver and LDAC for ~€44.
tagline: The 2025 successor: Bluetooth 6.0, 7-hour battery, beryllium driver, and parametric EQ.
sound_summary: Fixes the original model's modest battery life while retaining the class-leading vocal fidelity and adding in-app parametric EQ.
takeaway: The 2025 evolution of the budget wireless champion. Fixes the original model's biggest flaw by upgrading single-charge battery life to 7 hours (24 hours total with case). Upgrades to Bluetooth 6.0, adds an on-chip AI NPU for clearer voice calls, and integrates a 5-band parametric EQ directly into the Moondrop Link app. Still keeps the signature transparent hangar case and anime voice lines, while remaining the audiophile sound benchmark under €35.
fit_verdict: 5.4mm oval nozzle • Lightweight, secure fit with improved case retention magnets.

Add in Bluetooth 6.0, LDAC, and Qi wireless charging, and it sets the new sub-€55 benchmark.
